# Phase 0 Synthetic Corpus

These fixtures contain invented data only. They exercise Markdown ingestion, English and Chinese retrieval, unique-token isolation, and citation behavior without exposing personal or company documents.

- `alice-private.md` represents an owner-private Personal Note.
- `public-handbook-en.md` and `public-handbook-zh.md` represent publishable RAG content.
- `queries.jsonl` records reusable retrieval expectations for later benchmarks.

The unique sentinels are deliberate test identifiers, not credentials.
